title: FC 5103: Classification of Aerosol Products
officialText:
5103.1 Classification levels.

Aerosol products shall be classified as Level 1, 2 or 3 in accordance with FC 5102.1. Aerosol products in cartons which are not identified shall be classified as Level 3.

5103.2 Identification.

Cartons shall be identified on at least one side with the classification level of the aerosol products contained within the carton as follows: LEVEL ________ AEROSOLS.
